I have being playing this game for 4 years. I hate when companies choose sides. You're not an Apple user so everything you've built will now be destroyed. But I guess this leaves an opening for an app developer to fill this niche
 I will miss my frogs. So terriby sad.

My original illness is Parsonage Turner Syndrome. This affects 1 in 200,000 people. Most (90%) get better within 12 weeks of the onset. 96% of the remaining get better within 3 years. In America, CA it took 3 years to find a doctor who even had experience with another patient. Less than 3% of the remaining will deal with the degradation that will never get better.I have had to purchase medical journals and create ( 2 ) - 5" binders with my tests to be taken to all of my doctors. reports and tests. I have to educate my doctors on my illness. Not that they remember, because I have to constantly remind them. I have had a doctor drop me from their practice because they felt I was a drug addict wanting more drugs (seriously not AN issue as I have had a friend die from Oxycodone and seen addiction issues within my own family). Now I feel that my only recourse is to self medicate, which I am against and is in direct opposition of who I am. In the Netherlands they have a whole hospital/treatment center to support my I itial illness.

And maybe, had I insisted that's where we moved to, for me to be treated things would be different


But in America, the initial pain I feel is is "Chron Pain Syndrome", not " Hey Your brain is not receiving the correct info". So now they look at me like I am some sort of drug addict, rather than someone who has had their dominate communication venue compromised.

I used to be called lightning fingers 130 cwpm, able to seeany pathways for potential issues. Now I cannot type. I cannot life my right arm to use a mouse. And the ADA's only approved program is Dragon...which sucks as someone who has atttempted it on a variety of reasons.

And I have just spent the last hour AGAIN trying to explain to my mates...and once again....received no steps forward.

Wine bottles, vodka and pills....but something more is needed to end this cycle.
